scope: Local synthetic application assessment; not hosted or live-provider evidence.

methodology.browser: Chromium 154, installed system executable; same for before/after
methodology.mobile: 390x844, 4x CPU slowdown, 150ms latency, 200000 B/s down, 93750 B/s up
methodology.readiness: Driver action through named control assertion and two animation frames; includes driver/polling overhead
methodology.baseline: 8ecd5e04d plus first-round Consent retry fix and opt-in stress harness
methodology.optimized: after-heavy-2 and after-heavy-3, before integration with newer trunk; run 3 additionally reuses exact money formatters
methodology.integrated: 243c16941; final heavy and extreme verification, including remote-draft and midnight freshness corrections
limitations: Small repeated sample set, shared host without CPU isolation. Not confidence intervals or production p95.
Sequential stress actions share admission state. Later cold pages can encounter a different remaining allowance after faster earlier actions.
Failed/time-limited samples have no speedup ratio. Conditional skipped actions reduce the measured set.
Full-suite wall-clock diagnostics include fixtures, assertions, deliberately held responses and controlled clocks; not application readiness latency.
No deployment credentials, real-provider measurement, million-row breaking-tier run, exhaustive route-state Cartesian product, or universal 2x/zero-wait result.
